xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: This is to inform that the Company had received a letter of non-compliance from the Exchange for a delay in uploading the Integrated Filing (XBRL) containing Related Party Transaction details under Regulation 23(9) on the NEAPS portal. In this regard, a fine of Rs 50,000/- was imposed by the Exchange.In view of the above, the Company submitted an application seeking waiver of the imposed fine to the NSE but NSE rejected the wavier application and perferrred to impose fine of Rs.50,000/- vide its order dated February 16, 2026. The fine has been paid by the company.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: ASSISTANT COMMISSIONER CENTRAL GOODS AND SERVICE TAX, DIVISION-VII, GHAZIABAD
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr:
In the considered opinion of the Company’s legal counsel, the demand raised by the Hon’ble GST Authority on account of the alleged misclassification of one of the Company’s products is not sustainable in law. Accordingly, the Company filed an appeal against the said order before the appropriate appellate authority on April 25, 2025.
The matter was initially listed for hearing on December 29, 2025; however, it was adjourned to January 2, 2026. On the said date, the hearing was again adjourned. Subsequently, the appellate authority, vide its order dated February 26, 2026, partially accepted the Company’s submissions and modified the impugned order to that extent.
However, based on the advice of its legal counsel, the Company has decided to further challenge the order passed by the appellate authority before the appropriate forum.
